mechanism: `Stream`/`StreamController` are in-isolate queues, not CSP channels across processes. Cross-isolate, `SendPort`/`ReceivePort` are untyped message pipes.
why: Need a queue abstraction without importing Erlang.
useWhen: Event buses inside an isolate; worker isolates for handoff.
price: No select-over-channels in the language; backpressure is library-level.
